mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant renal toxicity and electrolyte wasting (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia); prednisolone augments these effects and increases infection risk through immunosuppression.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), renal function closely; consider liposomal amphotericin B formulation; maintain prednisolone at lowest effective dose; supplement electrolytes aggressively.
